401 Unauthorized error on web search due to invalid API credentials

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"model":"brave/web-search","query":"test"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.search(req).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
